display_name: Project Clarity — Retail Search & Conversion Business Glossary
description: Verified enterprise business definitions used by Google Cloud Data Agent Kit (@skill:discovering-gcp-data-assets) to eliminate SQL hallucinations and ground semantic search.

categories.description: Standardized e-commerce search efficacy and monetization definitions.
Definitions for query length cohorts and ranking bias adjustments.

terms.definition: Percentage of non-bot search sessions where at least one displayed impression results in a completed purchase event within the same 30-minute session window.
terms.canonical_sql_formula: SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN purchased = 1 THEN search_event_id END), COUNT(DISTINCT search_event_id))

terms.definition: Total net order revenue (USD) attributed to search-driven purchases divided by total non-bot search sessions, multiplied by 1,000.

A normalized user search query containing 4 or more whitespace-delimited tokens (e.g., 'ergonomic mesh home office chair under 300') that specifies composite intent attributes such as room, material, style, or price ceiling.

Historical click and conversion logs suffer from examination decay (Rank 1 receives ~4.5x the attention of Rank 8 regardless of true relevance). During training, displayed_rank_position is included as a control feature; during ML.PREDICT inference, displayed_rank_position is fixed to 1 for all candidates to score unbiased intrinsic relevance.
terms.canonical_sql_formula: 1 AS displayed_rank_position /* Counterfactual Rank-1 setting inside ML.PREDICT */
